==Advantages==
* The presence of Lojban on the web should be more automated. LMW has Twitter/Facebook plugin. twitter.com and facebook.com are very popular websites. Any changes to LMW are automatically posted without user interaction to special groups:
** twitter.com/uitki
** https://www.facebook.com/LojbanHQ
** so people can see Lojbanic news in their feeds
* LMW has wysiwyg editing plugin so in some cases you can edit text like in MS Word without knowing wiki syntax.
